name: gap_fade_reversion_5s_3
author: adapted from QuantGen_Subagent_2
thesis: Overnight gaps caused by retail overreaction or minor news are often overextended. Institutional participants use the morning liquidity to fade the gap and revert to previous day's value area. Exists due to overnight liquidity vacuums.
mechanism: Opening gaps trigger stop-loss cascades from overnight position holders, overshooting fair value. As the cascade exhausts, institutional VWAP algorithms begin working counter-gap orders, and fresh participants enter at the perceived discount or premium, driving price back toward the prior close or VWAP level within the first 15-30 minutes.

conditions: gap_pct < -20 AND close > open AND volume > SMA(volume, 5)
gap_pct > 20 AND close < open AND volume > SMA(volume, 5)

weaknesses: Runaway gaps (gap and go) will trigger maximum stop losses
Earnings or major macroeconomic news can completely invalidate the mean reversion thesis
Often crowded trade in the first 15 minutes
adaptation_notes: Converted from 5min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 60x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
